The planner's argument is correct and is the proof (8 lines, tactic mode, no auxiliary constants): causallyPlain_of_locZ with S := ∅; LocZplus C from hN.2 (C.dual.ChronalPastNeighbours) applied in the open W ⊓ ⟨interior N, isOpen_interior⟩, y being in it by mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds; LocZminus C ∅ from hN.1 likewise; the chronology is carried from W ⊓ interior N to W by C.lt_mono inf_le_left; the point lies in N by interior_subset; interior ∅ = ∅ is interior_empty. sharpness: chronal_neighbours cannot be dropped: the lightlike line has push-up and is not causally plain (Causal.deux_pushup, first component; Causal.lightlikeLine_not_causallyPlain); it has no chronal neighbours (≪ = ∅). This is the ladder's [[fails]] push_up → causally_plain.

push_up cannot be dropped: Causal.timelikeLineTop (Causal.Morphism; ≤_ℝ total, ≪ the timelike line's) has chronal neighbours (timelikeLine_chronalNeighbours, by defeq), fails push-up (1 ≪_ℝ 2 ≤_ℝ 0, not 1 ≪_ℝ 0) and is not causally plain (Int J⁺_ℝ({0}) = ℝ ⊄ closure I⁺_ℝ({0}) = [0, ∞)). All three were checked by a /tmp probe and are not in the library; they are T-abs-timelike-line-top's to land, which also settles the [[open]] chronal_neighbours → causally_plain (programme/ladder.toml:1792-1795). for_keeper.consistent_with: Every recorded counterexample into causally_plain lacks chronal neighbours or push-up: the lightlike line (push-up, ≪ = ∅), the spacelike line (≪ = ∅), the jump line (no chronal neighbours, per its notes), timelikeLineTop (not push-up), the gated line and the rational line (≪ fails at ⋆ / ≪ = ∅, argued). deuxPushup (plain, not push-up) is consistent trivially. The simulated ladder with the edge reports no contradiction.
consequences: With absolutely_minimal ∧ causally_plain ⇒ push_up (T1, Causal.Causality.pushUp_of_causallyPlain_of_absolutelyMinimal): on T1 spaces, for absolutely minimal causalities with chronal neighbours, push_up ⟺ causally_plain.

notes: Strict-library refactor. No statement changed, no declaration disappeared or was renamed, and exactly one public declaration is new (the ladder theorem). Each moved declaration exists exactly once, under its old full name and with its old type and proof term (dump). For the master: (1) Root imports, README rows, curation :496 (required, the ett ledger check fails until it is done) and the kb corrections are listed in master_changes. (2) The keeper's entry is in for_keeper; nothing in programme/ was touched. (3) For the author, evidence and not a ruling. OQ-16 (registers/DECISIONS.md:172) asks whether E≥0-manifolds are causally plain, as prop:K_calcul's route through prop:tarentin_fort_K assumes. Two facts bear on it. Every strongly causal SingularFlatAxioms spacetime is causally plain (SingularFlatAxioms.causallyPlain, now in Causal.SingularFlatPlain), and E₀ is (E0.causallyPlain). The new edge does not reach singular flat spacetimes with a BTZ point, which has no chronal past neighbour (I⁻(p) = ∅). There the S = sing₀ form of causallyPlain_of_locZ applies, and it needs strong causality to localise Z±. rem:pas_plat (ETT.tex:289-298), sentence 1 ('This is the push-up property') and item (ii) (l.294, plainness failing at a BTZ point): kb/0029 and SingularFlatAxioms.causallyPlain already contradict (ii) for strongly causal singular flat spacetimes. The new edge plus pushUp_of_causallyPlain_of_absolutelyMinimal shows that plainness and push-up coincide for absolutely minimal T1 causalities with chronal neighbours, the regime of Lorentzian manifolds, though not at BTZ points. In general they are independent (Causal.deux_pushup, as ETT.tex:303-305 itself says). (4) Not done, outside the dispatch: separate lemmas ChronalNeighbours.locZplus / .locZminus (the two steps are inside the proof; exposing them would add declarations); the timelikeLineTop sharpness witnesses (T-abs-timelike-line-top); the model plainness corollaries (a model module). (5) No git command that writes was run. The scratch files (/tmp/hpl: HEAD copies, dumps, probes, ladder simulation) were deleted after this report was written. The working tree also has changes by others: programme/roadmap.toml, roadmap/roadmap.toml, lean-causal/scaffold/CausalScaffold/ChronalTarentin.lean, and lean-benzecri / lean-syracuse files.
